sentences.en: When the king came in, the choir began intoning praises.
sentences.zh: 国王进来时，唱诗班开始吟诵赞美诗。

sentences.en: The choir sung an a capella version of the song.
sentences.zh: 唱诗班用无伴奏合唱的形式演唱了这首歌。

sentences.en: He assigned the kazoo parts to a large four-part men's choir.
sentences.zh: 他把萨克斯管的部分分配给了一个大型的四声部男声合唱团。
